checks: Missing export/read permission, expired authentication and foreign tenant produce no export or financial effects
Record revision and object ownership checked before export
Proposed correction exports linked original journal/approval and exact amount with verified file bytes; no approval implied
Exact export replay returns identical retained bytes, receipt and one issuance audit
Rejected correction exports as rejection; reusing another request key is refused
Approved evidence includes exact compensating lines and reopening while excluding unrelated metadata, certificate payload and raw dimensions
Earlier correction can be exported after cycle-two posting; replay retains old snapshot and new export labels current observed status separately
Corrupted referenced journal blocks export until its real evidence is restored
Retained download corruption is refused on retry
Late export audit failure rolls back issued bytes and receipt
Concurrent duplicate export yields one durable request and safe replay
History pagination returns all 33 records exactly once across timestamp ties and excludes export receipts
scope: Owned synthetic source corrections and actual evidence export service; no external messages, payments, statutory approval or professional certification.
